title: VTA Contexts List — payload
description: Request payload for vta/contexts/list. Takes no filters: the result is already narrowed to what the caller may reach.

contexts.description: Contexts the caller may access, in maintainer-defined order. An empty array means the caller can reach none — which is a successful answer, and is not distinguishable from a VTA that holds none. A caller needing that distinction wants vta/contexts/get on a known id, which answers notFound.
